understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to place every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+' simultaneously; completing all levels wins the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move one 3-pixel grid cell per directional action when not blocked. Adjacent pushable blocks can potentially be pushed, while walls and boundaries impede movement. Multiple pieces can be controlled by CLICK using their pixel coordinates, though clicking an occupied or incorrect position may have no effect. Every goal must be occupied at once, and each level has a limited action budget.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to place every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+' simultaneously; completing all levels wins the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move one 3-pixel grid cell per directional action when not blocked. Adjacent pushable blocks can potentially be pushed, while walls and boundaries impede movement. Multiple pieces can be controlled by CLICK using their pixel coordinates, though clicking an occupied or incorrect position may have no effect. Every goal must be occupied at once, and each level has a limited action budget.
